scope: Fictional fixtures in isolated browser contexts; no real user records or credentials.

checks: Encrypted vault starts with fictional data and preserves account source of truth
Actual salary, bank transfer, ATM, cash, Suica, PayPay, card top-up and settlement avoid double counting
Forecast salary is not money; deferred family debt becomes reserved only after repayment is enabled
Repeated import and pending-to-posted update keep one expense; recurring costs release their reserve
A manual duplicate remains until the user explicitly merges it; category and memo survive
Receipt image review fallback creates one cash expense and stores no image by default
A new card suggests payment day 10 and requires its real closing day
An archived account still protects its linked card against deletion and broken backup references
Purchase preview changes only the displayed result and never books a transaction
Analysis toggles between the true calendar month and the current salary cycle
Home, money, sync, analysis, history, timeline, debt and income fit 375/390/430/768px in light and dark modes
Account, financial transaction, receipt and salary data are absent from plaintext IndexedDB/localStorage/sessionStorage; no external requests

checks.name: Runtime source excludes plaintext browser storage, console output and client secrets
Moneytree API restricts token destination and disables browser response caching
Service Worker caches static app/OCR assets only; receipt image saving is explicit and OCR remains local
Atomic legacy migration decrypts every seeded financial record and draft unchanged
Native IndexedDB inspection: every non-metadata store is encrypted; every persisted index is blinded
Fresh IVs, locked-tab rejection, key disposal and wrong-passphrase preservation
Schema 1 compatibility, schema 2 round trip and encrypted export; provider credentials excluded
Injected migration failure leaves all legacy records intact and the vault disabled
Mock/manual and unconfigured Moneytree adapters perform zero network requests or credential writes

privacy.scope: Runtime source review and disposable fake IndexedDB with fictional fixtures; not a penetration test or device-storage recovery guarantee.

checks: 誤ったPINでは登録不可。正しいPINで確認後の登録キャンセルでも以前のPIN設定を保持

設定内の『認証を試す』で署名検証と成功表示を確認
